DK29.0 is a medical diagnosis code representing acute hemorrhagic gastritis. In the context of the Danish healthcare system's clinical quality development for cardiovascular diseases, specifically within the Danish Database for Atrial Fibrillation, this code plays a specific role in tracking patient outcomes. It is utilized as part of a broader set of diagnostic codes to measure the incidence of severe bleeding events among patients diagnosed with [[atrieflimren]] [^src1].

To accurately capture the incidence of severe bleeding, the clinical quality indicators employ a comprehensive range of ICD-10-DK diagnosis codes. DK29.0 is grouped within the gastrointestinal bleeding category, alongside codes ranging from [[dk25-0|DK25.0]] to [[dk29-8a|DK29.8A]] and [[dk92-0|DK92.0]] to [[dk92-2|DK92.2]] [^src1]. This specific indicator also tracks intracranial bleeding (using codes like [[di60|DI60]] through [[ds066|DS066]]) and urinary or respiratory tract bleeding (using codes such as [[dj942|DJ942]], [[dn02|DN02]], [[dr04|DR04]], and [[dr31|DR31]]) to ensure a complete clinical picture of hemorrhagic complications in this patient population [^src1]. The code and its application are consistently documented across successive annual reports from the Regionernes Kliniske Kvalitetsudviklingsprogram (RKKP), appearing in both the 2023 and 2024 methodology definitions [^src1] [^src2].
